scope: A single Ascension 0 Ironclad teaching run. This is experience evidence, not an automatic strategy update.
verified_observations: The displayed boss name was Hexaghost with 250 maximum HP.
Hexaghost used Inflame (12 Block and 2 Strength) and later produced Burn pressure.
At one point the hand contained three Burns, one Defend, and one Strike at 1 HP; a 5-Block Defend could not cover six visible Burn damage.
Fiend Fire+ was used successfully as burst damage after a draw card.
Shockwave+ and Bash applied debuffs visible on the boss.

agent_failures.statement: The boss was initially identified from visual appearance as Slime Boss before readable name confirmation.
agent_failures.remediation: Require readable boss name before retrieving or applying a boss profile.

agent_failures.statement: Some move symbols were interpreted without using the expanded intent tooltip and total multi-hit arithmetic.
agent_failures.remediation: Require confirmed total incoming damage, including every hit, before approving End Turn.

agent_failures.statement: End-of-turn Burn damage was not consistently included in survival forecasts.
agent_failures.remediation: Require visible end-of-turn status damage in the combat preflight when it is present.

confidence: single-run experience; do not generalize without future corroboration
